python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
anchor = fluentqt.Button("Workspace", %PARENT%)
anchor.setFixedSize(112, 32)
anchor.move(234, 129)
anchor.show()
control = fluentqt.CoachMark(%PARENT%)
control.setCardSize(QSize(210, 102))
control.setTarget(anchor)
layout = QVBoxLayout(control.contentHost())
layout.setContentsMargins(14, 10, 14, 10)
layout.setSpacing(4)
heading = fluentqt.Label("New workspace", control.contentHost())
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
layout.addWidget(heading)
body = fluentqt.Label("Switch views or pin folders here.", control.contentHost())
body.setWordWrap(True)
body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(body)
layout.addStretch(1)
acknowledge = fluentqt.Button("Got it", control.contentHost())
acknowledge.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
acknowledge.setFixedHeight(26)
layout.addWidget(acknowledge, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight)
acknowledge.clicked.connect(control.close)
anchor.clicked.connect(control.open)
control.open()
